svg.data-weight: 3.9 kg (8.6 lb) for the 7010TX-48, -48C, -48-DC and -48C-DC (guide Table 1, data sheet)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 25.8 cm (19 x 1.75 x 10.0 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-depth-with-fans: 27.6 cm (10.8 in) "incl. fans" (data sheet); the modelled 258.0 mm is the guide's
svg.data-ports-max-speed: 52 ports of 1 Gbps; four ports of 10 Gbps; four ports of 25 Gbps
svg.data-psu-redundancy: 1+1; two internal supplies, at least one of which must be connected
svg.data-input-ac: 100 - 240 VAC, 2.2 A, 50/60 Hz (guide Table 3), IEC 60320 C14
svg.data-input-dc: -40 to -72 VDC, 2.5 A, AWG 14 to 18 ring lug (guide Tables 3 and 4)
svg.data-noise: 46.5 dBA typical at 27 C, 56.5 dBA maximum (data sheet)
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent non-condensing (guide Table 2); the data sheet says 5 to 95 percent
svg.data-memory: 4 GB for the 7010TX-48 and -48-DC; 8 GB for the -48C and -48C-DC (data sheet)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the front, 9600 baud 8N1, no flow control
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the front
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the front, for software or configuration updates
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI (data sheet)
